stage1.impression: A clean, crisp high-key product shot: the red acrylic, the internals and the horn read instantly and the black edge lines give the box its shape. But it looks pasted onto a flat white field, with no shadow to hold it to the floor and a hard diagonal seam on the right. The glow happens only in the horn; the cabinet reads as a dark brick-red box, and the white has a faint green cast.

blocking_9: A soft, believable shadow that grounds the cabinet: the floor beside and behind the base visibly darker than the open seamless (about 225-240 against 248), not brighter
The cabinet's acrylic glows like the horn: side and front panels median luminance above 110 instead of about 89, so the whole object reads as lit-through stained glass
Neutral white seamless (R, G and B within 1 of each other), with no green cast
No visible set edge or seam anywhere in frame
The horn's red holds its saturation instead of going pink (G and B well under R)
A full-resolution 2560 x 1440 final with clean edges on the posts and the horn rim

defects.what: Hard diagonal line where the sweep ends on the right, a visible set edge (step 24 levels, zero width)
Floor beside and behind the base is brighter (250) than the open seamless (248): there is no cast shadow, so the product floats
Contact shadow is a 10-15 px line that recovers to 246 within about 25 px; there is no soft penumbra
Background white is green-tinted: R 245-246, G 248-249, B 245-246
Cabinet side panel is dull and dark (median 89), with no transmitted glow; it reads as painted, not lit-through
Horn reads pink and washed (RGB about 251/125/129, median 152), out of balance with the darker cabinet below

changes.problem: The background lamps spill onto the floor around the base, filling in any shadow, so the product floats.

evidence.measured: floor right of the base is median 250, brighter than the open background (248); the left side is 246

changes.problem: There is no cast shadow giving the 1.3 m object weight; the key is too soft and too weak against the fill to read.

evidence.measured: profile toward the right is flat at 249-250; nothing falls away from the base
